_doc: CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM as data (owner, 2026-11-12). Loaded by foundation/closedloop.py, `python3 -m foundation closedloop --check` (a step in checks.yml) and by the executor prompt. Prose is never the enforcement; this file is.
axiom: CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM: Every loop is closed by the system itself. No step depends on a person reading, deciding, reviewing or approving, and nothing is ever assumed to be read. Every output has a code consumer (registered in doctrine/consumers.json). Every open item has an automatic owner, trigger and probe. A credential only the owner can mint becomes an automated acquisition attempt across every surface plus a staged default in effect, never a document or a card. A document, memory or note that no code consumes is not produced.
rules: no-human-in-the-loop: no step depends on a human reading, deciding, reviewing or approving
consumer-for-every-output: every generated artifact has a code consumer in doctrine/consumers.json
automatic-open-items: every open item has an automatic owner, trigger and probe
acquire-then-stage: an owner-only credential is an automated acquisition attempt on all surfaces plus a staged default
human-controls-replaced: CODEOWNERS, protected-change labels and required human reviews are replaced by automated gates (required checks, bot approval, canary, revert)
